summary: Revert task-specific prompt leakage in toolset.py to restore generic resilience instruction.

edits.hypothesis: Removing the verbose, task-specific 'high-risk scenario' instruction eliminates leakage while retaining the core directive to re-examine pixels when tools disagree or fail.
edits.why_not_lower_lever: The previous edit introduced specific phrasing that triggered leakage detection; reverting to the concise, accepted version preserves the behavioral fix without the flagged content.
edits.trigger_condition: Always active for M-arm tasks using AGENT_SYSTEM.
edits.retroactive_check: (corrective) The retained instruction 'If tools disagree or a high-resolution inspection fails, do NOT uncritically accept negative consensus' still addresses the failure mode in q000002/q000004/q000008 by prompting pixel re-examination. (preservative) Removes the specific 'CRITICAL' block that was flagged as overfitting. (transfer) Generalizes to any tool failure scenario.
edits.regression_risk: Minimal; reverts to the previously accepted state which had positive accuracy gains.
edits.mechanism: Removing the verbose, task-specific 'high-risk scenario' instruction eliminates leakage while retaining the core directive to re-examine pixels when tools disagree or fail.
